h: British rapper Stefflon Don reveals birth of second child
p: British rapper Stefflon Don has revealed that she welcomed her second child, a son named Don Claes, in April, drawing congratulations from Tiwa Savage and others.
body: British rapper Stefflon Don has announced the birth of her second child.

In an interview published on Friday, 13 November 2026, the rapper revealed that she gave birth to a baby boy, Don Claes, on 23 April 2026, and shared maternity photos and a picture with her newborn. She said motherhood continues to reshape her as a person.
Tiwa Savage congratulated her in the comments, and talent manager Jada P also sent love. Her post drew wide attention on Nigerian social media because of her past relationship with Burna Boy.
Stefflon Don is known for hits such as 'Hurtin' Me'.
more: Her son Don Claes was born in April.
